name: week
title: Group close: the week
subtitle: Read-only management review. Blank amounts are unknown.

sections.title: Entity submissions
sections.sql: select period,entity,owner,due_on,status,actual_rows,incomplete_rows,reconciled_by from entity_readiness order by due_on,entity

sections.title: Open follow-ups
sections.sql: select code,name,owner,due_on from actions where status='open' order by due_on

name: results
title: Group results
subtitle: Debit-positive signed balances in group currency. Provisional until period review.

sections.title: Actual and budget
sections.sql: select period,scenario,group_code,group_name,kind,base_amount,missing_values from group_results order by period,scenario,group_code

sections.title: Source readiness
sections.sql: select period,entity,actual_rows,incomplete_rows,reconciled_by from entity_readiness order by period,entity

name: intercompany
title: Intercompany review
subtitle: Source balances before elimination. Compare with posted journals.

sections.title: Balances to match
sections.sql: select period,entity,group_code,base_amount from intercompany_review order by period,entity,group_code

sections.title: Elimination journal register
sections.sql: select j.code,j.name,p.code period,j.status,j.prepared_by,j.reviewed_by,sum(l.amount) balance_amount from journals j join periods p on p.id=j.period_id left join journal_lines l on l.journal_id=j.id group by j.id,p.code order by p.code,j.code
